about.title: About EduBridge Agency
about.missionText: EduBridge Agency exists to bridge the gap between students and life-changing educational opportunities. We believe that every student, regardless of their background or location, deserves access to information about scholarships and educational pathways that can transform their future.
about.visionText: A world where no talented student misses an educational opportunity due to lack of information or guidance.
about.verificationText: Every opportunity on EduBridge Agency is reviewed and verified by our team. We require official source documentation for verification. We never fabricate or exaggerate scholarship information.
